title: E2E: Suggestions beta gating + schema validation + CI integration
author: Leila Farouk
release_notes: Adds CI-gated E2E coverage for Suggestions beta gating and schema validation (read-only). No user-facing behavior changes beyond test + CI coverage.
body:
Context: This adds end-to-end coverage for the new Console "Suggestions" (beta) pages to prevent regressions around feature-flag/allowlist gating and to ensure the UI remains compatible with the versioned suggestions payload (savings + risk). The intent is to catch the common failure modes we saw in staging (gating leaks across tenants, missing telemetry edge cases, schema drift) before we enable more beta accounts.

Scope:
- E2E tests (Playwright) for Suggestions list + detail drawer:
  - Flag OFF => Suggestions nav item hidden and direct route returns gated state (no data leak, no partial rendering)
  - Flag ON but tenant not allowlisted => gated state shown with correct copy and no API calls beyond "capabilities" probe
  - Flag ON + allowlisted + user has permission => list renders, filters work, drawer opens, and basis-of-estimate sections render
  - RBAC negative cases: allowlisted tenant but user role lacks permission => 403 => UI shows permission state (no suggestion IDs surfaced)
  - Error/empty handling: "insufficient telemetry" and "stale estimate" states render consistently (no unhandled promise rejections)
- Schema validation:
  - Validates suggestions-service payload against a pinned JSON schema snapshot (savings_estimate v1 + risk fields) so we fail loudly on breaking contract changes
  - Adds a small contract test harness that can be reused when we bump to savings_estimate v1.1 (per ENG-2410 follow-ups)
- CI integration:
  - Adds a dedicated CI job for Console E2E ("console-e2e-suggestions") running against the seeded test tenant
  - Runs on PRs touching console suggestions routes, BFF integration, feature-flag plumbing, or schema files; can be manually triggered otherwise
  - Uploads Playwright traces + screenshots on failure; adds a short flake retry (1x) while we stabilize selectors

Test approach / fixtures:
- Uses a seeded tenant (tenant_id: e2e-suggest-beta) with deterministic suggestion IDs and a stable baseline window.
- Network stubbing is limited to auth and tenant capability probes; suggestions list/detail are served by the test environment so we validate the real BFF->service wiring.
- Selectors use data-testid attributes added in earlier UI PRs; avoids text-based selectors except for static gating copy.

Notes:
- This intentionally does not test "apply" flows (beta is read-only).
- If suggestions-service is down, the tests should fail (that’s the point). The suite includes a preflight health check that prints actionable debug output (service URL, request id) rather than timing out.

Related:
- ENG-2406
- PRs that this depends on conceptually: feature flag plumbing and Suggestions UI/BFF integration (landed earlier in the train).

Screenshots/Artifacts:
- CI uploads trace.zip and screenshot diffs under Buildkite artifact tab on failure.
commits: test(e2e): validate suggestions payload schema (savings_estimate v1 + risk fields)
ci: add console-e2e-suggestions job + artifacts on failure
test(fixtures): seed deterministic tenant + suggestion IDs for stable runs
chore: add data-testid fallbacks for flaky selectors
review_conversation: Chloe Martin (review): Can we make sure the "flag off" test also asserts we never call /suggestions from the browser? We had one bug where the UI hid the nav but still fetched on route prefetch.
Leila Farouk (author): Yep — added a network assertion that fails if any request hits /api/console/suggestions when suggestions_beta is false. Also added a note in the test about route prefetch.
Kaitlyn Nguyen (review): For RBAC negative case, can we ensure we don't expose suggestion IDs in the DOM or logs? Even though it's read-only, IDs are still sensitive if they can be correlated.

Leila Farouk (author): Updated the 403 test to assert the table is not rendered and that no suggestion_id appears in DOM text. Also added a log scrub in the test harness so we don't print payloads on failures for 403 paths.

Dylan Brooks (review): Selector stability: please avoid nth-child selectors in the list tests. Prefer data-testid on the row and on the drawer open button. Also, we should run this suite only when suggestions-related paths change, otherwise PR latency will climb.

Leila Farouk (author): Removed nth-child selectors; added row testids using suggestion_id hash suffix in the seed (stable). CI job now uses path filters (console suggestions routes + schemas + buildkite step) and remains manually triggerable.
Connor O'Brien (review): CI integration looks good. Can we cap runtime? The first run took ~14m. We should target <8m for PR gating.
Leila Farouk (author): Split the suite into two projects (chromium only for PR gating; webkit/firefox optional nightly). Reduced trace recording to on-failure. Now ~6–7m on CI.
Nora Ahmed (review): Schema pinning: where does the schema live and how do we bump it? We should document the process so we don't block iteration.
Leila Farouk (author): Added console/src/routes/suggestions/__tests__/README.md with "how to bump schema" steps and a reminder to coordinate with ADR-0275/ENG-2410 when adding fields.
Dylan Brooks (review): Approved after the selector cleanup + runtime improvement.
Chloe Martin (review): Approved. Thanks for adding the network assertion; this would have caught our staging prefetch issue.
